Dental Self-Care v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Evidence-based self-managed oral health routines for people lacking insurance, in remote or unpredictable work, or facing high costs.
- Agent personalizes daily care protocols, maintains symptom/supply trackers, sets reminders, and logs adherence.
- Home remedies, decision trees for symptoms, and clear escalation steps reduce emergency risk.
- Researches local low-cost providers, drafts communication scripts, and automates supply/inventory tracking.
- Keeps human focused on physical care; agent handles planning, reminders, and admin.
